_comments._comments: Documentation only. Excluded from generated runtime configuration. Change settings below, then regenerate config or rebuild and reload.
_comments.timing: Messaging pace. A random pre-typing pause is followed by length-proportional typing. Duration settings are milliseconds; speed is characters per minute.
_comments.timing.beforeTypingMinimumMs: Shortest random pause after sending before generation and the typing indicator start. Default 1000 = 1 second; 0 allows an immediate start.
_comments.timing.beforeTypingMaximumMs: Longest random pre-typing pause. The pause is sampled uniformly between this value and beforeTypingMinimumMs. Must be at least that minimum.
_comments.timing.minimumMs: Minimum typing-phase target for very short replies. API generation time counts toward this duration.
_comments.chat: Editable message and room-name limits. These values must be positive integers.
_comments.chat.maximumMessageCharacters: Maximum user-message length, counted as JavaScript string units (some emoji count as two). Enforced by the input and engine.
_comments.chat.roomTitleCharacters: Maximum manually entered room-name length and automatic first-message title length, in JavaScript string units. Custom names are not overwritten by automatic naming.
_comments.debug: Local debug-log capacity, retention and export cleanup settings. Changes do not turn logging on; users still opt in each session.
_comments.debug.maximumBytes: Maximum retained log size in bytes, measured from UTF-8 JSON entries. 10485760 = 10 MiB. Older entries are removed first; individual oversized requests are not recorded.
_comments.debug.maximumEntries: Maximum number of API request log entries retained, newest first. Each character-generation or reply call counts separately.
_comments.debug.maximumAgeMs: Maximum log age in milliseconds from request start. 604800000 = 7 days. Expiry is enforced on startup and log access/writes, not by a background scheduler.
_comments.debug.exportUrlLifetimeMs: Milliseconds to keep the temporary JSON download URL alive after export begins. This is download cleanup timing, not a log-retention or file-expiry limit.
_comments.timing.charactersPerMinute: Base typing speed in Unicode code points per minute, including spaces and punctuation. 300 means 5 characters/second: 100 characters take about 20 seconds and 500 about 100 seconds. Must be greater than zero. There is no short duration cap.
_comments.timing.speedVariationFraction: Random fractional variation in typing speed for each reply. 0.12 samples speed within ±12% of charactersPerMinute; 0 disables variation. Must be at least 0 and less than 1. Generation time is subtracted from the resulting typing duration.
